title: Holomorphic curves of finite lower order with few inflection points
summary: We prove a conjecture proposed by the first-named author in 1998. Let $f\colon\mathbb{C}\to\mathbb{P}^n$ be a transcendental linearly non-degenerate holomorphic curve of finite lower order. If the counting function $N_1(r,f)$ of its Wronskian zeros satisfies $N_1(r,f)=o(T(r,f))$, then its order and lower order coincide and belong to $\{1+k/q:k\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0},\ 2\le q\le n+1\}$, and its characteristic is regularly varying.
